item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We refuse to treat that future as inevitable. We must prevent it.

2. We cannot accept a race toward superintelligent AI. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We demand that protecting human life come before building it.

3. We draw a clear line: no superintelligent AI within the next 20 years. Building it in that window will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We stand for prevention, not a gamble with humanity’s future.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We cannot accept that outcome, and we refuse to treat the race toward it as inevitable. We must stop the development of superintelligent AI within that window and put human survival ahead of competitive advantage, corporate ambition, and technological prestige. We are organising around a clear demand: prevent this catastrophe before it becomes irreversible. We will press for binding limits, public accountability, and the political courage to say no. We owe one another a future—not a race that ends in mass death.
